request.note: Tetris is published with verified installer/ZIP hashes. Full local engine validation took 2652.4 seconds across 57 commands. Production initially rejected a correct text-only Pocket Breaker studio card because a fixed 650ms screenshot caught its fade-in below the brightness threshold. Fixed Games startup verification in bc268c56c298: bounded polling of the unchanged raster criterion, retaining retired-artwork checks; Windows tests cover faded, opaque and missing titles; full production startup now passes. Cheap native-icon and portrait/landscape preflight should precede compilation. Add bounded retry and sanitized HTTP diagnostics for transient GitHub API failures; one interrupted this release despite valid access. Consider source-bound artifact reuse to reduce full-catalog rebuilds without weakening exact-source gates.
